sourceSentences: [0] Blitzcrank is just a counter because I mean, he can hook you in and he can combo and again, Thresh is a squishy support in general. He's not that tanky.
[0] How to play against Thresh? Again, the same thing. Force him to to miss the hook, a bit like Tahm Kench. Punish him when on cool down.
[0] Just make sure that you are careful with the E. Don't don't get E. So, don't be too close to him.
[0] Q has a long cool down, so please force it and punish after that. Vision on him makes it easier.
[0] Squishy support in general, it's the same as the thing as Thresh, but worse.
[1] It's because um I mean Thresh is a very squishy champion.
[1] So because he's very squishy, he gets hooked comboed and he can get burst bursted.
[1] And also, Thresh is a champion that likes to play very aggressive and Blitz is a really good um counter to that.
[1] And Thresh doesn't pressure melee, he pressures like with range.
[2] You never want to be the front line in fights because Thresh is very squishy as a character and has no way to get himself out of danger, only his allies.
[2] So to put it in a simple way, there are frontline champs, backline champs, and then there's Thresh, which is a sideline champ.
[3] Don't get hooked or you will go back to spawn by Grey Screen Express.
[3] If your teammate gets hooked - throw lantern to him.
[3] Hide behind minions and back off if they are low hp since he can try R>Q to kill minions quickly and hook you.
[3] Be aware that he can hook people out of your lantern if he times it right.
[3] Pretty much who gets hooked first between your adcs.
